notes.title: Path of Ra Steamfest Demo
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone ! 
It's Steamfest time today, for the occasion we will release a new demo for Path of Ra.

We improved the game based on player's feedback. 

So what's new in the demo :
- Hint system (you can now resquest a hint if you are stuck in a level)
- Report bug or feedback system is now accessible in the game (just press F10)
- Fixed many alternatives solutions (some level could be solve too easily so we slightly change the level design of these levels)
- Lots of minor fixes

Enjoy the demo and don't forget to wishlist the game if you like it ![/h3]
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1766000/Path_of_Ra/

notes.title: Path of Ra - Games Made in France Demo available
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone ! 
Today is a great day for us.
As we attend to the Games made in France event, it's time for us to release the first demo of the game.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2020830

[h3]A lot of things are still rough and may seems not working as intended but don't worry we are still working on it !
If you encounter a bug or want to report a feedback we invite you to fill this form : [url=https://forms.gle/Q47F3hMpR4qxVnPG7]Path of Ra - Bug and feedback form[/url]

We hope you will have a great time in Path of Ra ![/h3]
